records.title: Appointment of Chairperson of The National Trust and Rehabilitation Council of India
details:
(b): The National Trust for the Welfare of Persons with Autism, Cerebral Palsy, Mental Retardation and Multiple Disabilities is working for the welfare and empowerment of Persons with these categories of disabilities. Process of appointment of Chairperson National Trust is in advance stage and constitution of Search cum Selection Committee for having interactive session with the candidates is under process.
(c) It was inter-alia stated that filling up process of one vacancy of Member Secretary, RCI is also in advanced stage and screening of application has been completed and proposal is under process for referring the matter to Selection Committee for final recommendations.

records.title: Enhancing retirement age of civilian doctors of OFB
details: The proposal for enhancement of retirement age of civilian doctors of Ordnance Factory Board (OFB), belonging to Indian Ordnance Factories Health Service from 60 to 65 years is under active consideration of the Government.

records.title: Inquiry into coal imports
details: As per information made available by the Directorate of Revenue Intelligence (DRI), instances of over-invoicing in respect of coal import have been noticed by them and field formations have suitably been altered. Imports made in the past are under investigation.

records.title: Utilisation of MGNREGA funds
details: The Ministry has received a request to provide additional 50 days of employment over and above 100 days in drought notified areas from Government of Madhya Pradesh with the recommendation from the Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare. It is under consideration by the Ministry of Rural Development.

records.title: Cost of new Parliament project
details: Estimated cost of New Parliament Building is Rs. 971 crore. Detailed Project Report (DPR) and cost estimates of other buildings have not been finalized.
